title: Foundation Tilt and Settlement Monitor
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=structural:tilt
| timechart span=1d avg(tilt_deg) as tilt by point
| streamstats current=f last(tilt) as prev by point
| eval drift=abs(tilt-prev), alert=if(drift>0.05,1,0)
description: Monitors tilt sensors on the structure for slow changes that can indicate settlement or movement.
value: Structural movement is gradual and easy to miss; a tilt trend gives early, quantified warning worth a surveyor's visit.
implementation: Ingest tilt-sensor data into `index=personal`; alert on sustained tilt drift.
visualization: Line chart of structural tilt over time by point.
grandmaExplanation: It watches sensors on the house for slow tilting that could mean the ground is shifting underneath.
